requests.missing: the client board census - one TNG1N*/TNG1M* chapter with a Port Specifications table. The frame half is fully vendor-sourced: `TNG2DAP` section 1.9 gives E9605 = IU1-IU5, and the E9605 subrack chapter gives PIU/APIU IU100-IU101, EFI IU71-IU72 (`"The EFI board offers maintenance and management interfaces"`), fan IU90, five service boards in IU1-IU5, two CTU boards, 177 x 442 x 260 mm. What is missing is not findable by search: the vendor sitemap indexes 713 document pages and holds exactly two board chapters, both optical-layer (TNG2DAP EDFA, TNG3SRAPXF Raman+EDFA), with TNG1N*/TNG1M*/TNG1T*/TNV*/TNK*/TMB1* occurring zero times. Census of the support portal (2026-11-17, `research/optixtrans-support-portal-census.md`): the OSN 9800 M24 page links 174 document ids and 146 of them answer 302 -> /view/notFound, including its own Datasheet entry (OptiX OSN 9800 Board Datasheet, EDOC1000074739) - so the 2014-era EDOC1000 numbering is as closed as the current one. Of the 28 that open, 24 are videos and the two documents are the User Guide and the EUCC statement, neither of which contains "Port Specifications", "IU1" or TNG1N (zero occurrences each). That pair does carry Huawei's scope sentence placing the E9600 series (E9605/E9612/E9624/E9624X) beside the OSN 9800 M subracks as one hardware family, which is why an OSN 9800 board chapter would be acceptable for this family - but it prints no E9605->M05 pairing, so it is not a licence to borrow the M05 census.

requests.missing: the same client board chapter (TNG1N*/TNG1M*) - and the slot count is NOT mode-independent, which the earlier record had wrong. The E9612 subrack chapter gives 13 service slots (IU1-IU13) only in the E3CTU DC build: the older AUX+SCC layout is 12 (IU1-IU12) on DC, and under AC/HVDC power one APIU occupies IU1 and IU2 physically, leaving 10 (master) / 11 (slave); the E3CTU AC/HVDC build is IU3-IU13 = 11. So `IU1-IU13` in `TNG2DAP` section 1.9 is the E3CTU DC figure.
requests.unblock: one client board chapter, plus the power option and subrack layout to model (E3CTU DC = 13, AUX+SCC DC = 12, AC/HVDC = 10 or 11). No protection mode is needed.

requests.missing: the same client board chapter (TNG1N*/TNG1M*), plus the protection mode, which decides the port count: 1:1 gives 12 large or 24 small slots, 1:3 gives 10 or 20, and IU6/IU7/IU18/IU19 are unusable in 1:3. The frame arithmetic is settled and vendor-sourced (`TNG2DAP` section 1.9 and the E9600 family brochure); the board chapters are absent from the vendor sitemap, so this is an access problem, not a search problem. Correction (2026-11-17): the E9600 family is FOUR subracks, not three - `OptiXtrans E9624X` is a separate product with its own page and is absent from the family spec table (`E9624X` occurs zero times in the 344,531 B family page). It shares only the 12/24 slot count: 825 mm vs 747.2 mm tall, cross-connect SDH/OTN/fgOTN/PKT vs ODUk/PKT/VC, 10 Gbit/s OTN+TDM and 400 Gbit/s ponder vs 1.2 Tbit/s per channel, and -48/-60 V DC only vs DC/AC/HVDC. TNG2DAP section 1.9 lists it (IU1-IU24) and section 1.6 gives the functional split (`Opticallayer ASON: E9605/E9612/E9624 supported, E9624X subrack: Not supported`), so modelling #810 from the E9624X page would be the E6608-from-E6608T error again. Its own board datasheet (`EDOC1100214449`) is behind the same wall as `EDOC1100163901` (302 -> /view/notFound), so the wall now covers two named board datasheets. See `research/optixtrans-e9624x-fourth-subrack.md`.
requests.unblock: one client board chapter plus the protection mode to model (1:1 or 1:3) - `TNG1N206` (6 x 10 Gbit/s line), `TNG1N210` (10 x 10 Gbit/s line) or `TNG1N401` (1 x 100 Gbit/s line), which `TNG2DAP` section 1.9 shows is valid in all four subracks.
